title: City of Melbourne event permits 2014-2018: weddings, promotions, filming and public events, by date, category and place
provider: City of Melbourne, Open Data Platform (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1): dataset event-permits-2014-2018-including-film-shoots-photo-shoots-weddings-christmas-pa
credit: Event permits: City of Melbourne, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the dataset's metadata; checked 2026-11-04)
citation: City of Melbourne, Event permits 2014-2018 including film shoots, photo shoots, weddings, Christmas parties, promotions, fun runs and public events, https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/explore/dataset/event-permits-2014-2018-including-film-shoots-photo-shoots-weddings-christmas-pa/
format: CSV separated by semicolons, with a byte-order mark; one row a permit issued by the City's event booking system. Fields taken: event_start and event_end (civil dates, YYYY-MM-DD; a few ends are empty or before the start), category_1 (Wedding, Promotion, Filming - <kind>, Public Event - <kind>, Private Event; written by hand, with variants and misspellings), category_2 (rarely: Christmas Party, ...) and location (free text: the places booked, comma-separated, as the booking system names them: parks, squares, streets, 'Bourke St Mall - next to Tourism booth', 'Roads / Public Access Spaces'). The dataset's title, the activity's name, is not selected: private events and student films are named after people.
coverage: The municipality, 31 December 2013 to 19 February 2018, 2,827 permits (276 name Bourke Street); the dataset was published in 2020 and is not updated.
